name: Ending A Relationship
overview: Scripture teaches that ending a relationship should be approached with wisdom and trust in the Lord rather than in people, as human confidence can be unreliable and cause harm. Proverbs encourages careful withdrawal to prevent weariness and enmity, while also valuing honest correction from faithful friends who sharpen one another. Ultimately, God’s blessings and faithfulness remain steadfast, providing assurance even amid relational transitions.
